entry.title: Designing Context for Reliable Agents
entry.summary: Practical guidance for helping agents find relevant evidence, use it correctly, and verify their work. Informed by research on context, skills, and long tasks.

entry.title: Checkpoint Replay for Long-Horizon Agent Evaluation
entry.summary: Evaluate a 24-hour soak at recorded checkpoints. Restore the evidence and agent state available at each moment, then test the decisions.

entry.title: Local Context for Autonomous Agents
entry.summary: Put telemetry, logs, and topology beside the agent. Use PromQL and files to keep retrieval reliable and model context focused.

entry.title: Trustworthy Autonomy
entry.summary: Nine principles for systems that deserve the authority we give them. A field guide to evidence, boundaries, and learning from consequences.

entry.title: Engineering Autonomous Agents
entry.summary: An agent’s capabilities depend on its data, execution loop, state, and feedback. Design them as one system.
